```bash
# T15: durable restart demo with file H2
export JAVA_HOME=/home/mohammad-hashim/.jdks/jdk-21.0.12.1+1
export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
cd /home/mohammad-hashim/AI-learnings/Assesment/backend
rm -rf ./data
# Start app with local profile in background
./mvnw -q spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=local -Dspring-boot.run.jvmArguments="-Dserver.port=18080" > /tmp/tickets-t15.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /tmp/tickets-t15.pid
# Wait for health
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if curl -sf http://localhost:18080/actuator/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "UP after ${i}s"; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
curl -sf http://localhost:18080/actuator/health; echo
# Create ticket + comment
CREATE=$(curl -sf -X POST http://localhost:18080/api/tickets \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"title":"T15 restart check","description":"Must survive stop/start","assignee":"ops"}')
echo "$CREATE"
ID=$(echo "$CREATE" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["id"])')
curl -sf -X POST "http://localhost:18080/api/tickets/$ID/comments" \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"body":"Comment before restart","author":"ops"}' ; echo
# Stop app
kill $(cat /tmp/tickets-t15.pid) 2>/dev/null || true
# Also kill any leftover spring-boot child
pkill -f 'spring-boot:run.*18080' 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 3
# Confirm down
if curl -sf http://localhost:18080/actuator/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "STILL UP - force kill"; pkill -9 -f 'tickets.*0.0.1' || true; sleep 2; fi
# Restart
./mvnw -q spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=local -Dspring-boot.run.jvmArguments="-Dserver.port=18080" > /tmp/tickets-t15-b.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /tmp/tickets-t15.pid
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if curl -sf http://localhost:18080/actuator/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "RE-UP after ${i}s"; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
# Verify data
DETAIL=$(curl -sf "http://localhost:18080/api/tickets/$ID")
echo "$DETAIL"
echo "$DETAIL" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d["title"]=="T15 restart check"; assert len(d["comments"])==1; assert d["comments"][0]["body"]=="Comment before restart"; print("T15 RESTART OK", d["id"])'
# Cleanup
kill $(cat /tmp/tickets-t15.pid) 2>/dev/null || true
pkill -f 'spring-boot:run.*18080' 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 1
echo DONE

```

```bash
export JAVA_HOME=/home/mohammad-hashim/.jdks/jdk-21.0.12.1+1
export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
# Ensure previous processes are down
pkill -f 'server.port=18080' 2>/dev/null || true
pkill -f 'spring-boot:run' 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 2
ls -la /home/mohammad-hashim/AI-learnings/Assesment/backend/data/ 2>/dev/null || echo "no data dir"
# Restart against existing file DB
cd /home/mohammad-hashim/AI-learnings/Assesment/backend
./mvnw -q spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=local -Dspring-boot.run.jvmArguments="-Dserver.port=18080" > /tmp/tickets-t15-c.log 2>&1 &
echo $! > /tmp/tickets-t15.pid
for i in $(seq 1 90); do
  if curl -sf http://localhost:18080/actuator/health >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "UP ${i}s"; break; fi
  sleep 1
done
curl -sf http://localhost:18080/api/tickets?q=T15%20restart | python3 -m json.tool | head -40
ID=$(curl -sf 'http://localhost:18080/api/tickets?q=T15%20restart' | python3 -c 'import sys,json; c=json.load(sys.stdin)["content"]; print(c[0]["id"] if c else "")')
echo "ID=$ID"
if [ -n "$ID" ]; then
  curl -sf "http://localhost:18080/api/tickets/$ID" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d["title"]=="T15 restart check"; assert any(c["body"]=="Comment before restart" for c in d["comments"]); print("T15 RESTART OK")'
else
  echo "T15 FAIL: ticket missing after restart"
  tail -40 /tmp/tickets-t15-c.log
  exit 1
fi
kill $(cat /tmp/tickets-t15.pid) 2>/dev/null || true
pkill -f 'server.port=18080' 2>/dev/null || true
echo CLEANED
```

```bash
  sleep 1
done
ls -la "$PROOF_DIR"

# Phase 2: restart same file store
SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL="jdbc:h2:file:${PROOF_DIR}/tickets" \
SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME=sa \

./mvnw -q spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.profiles=local -Dspring-boot.run.jvmArguments="-Dserver.port=18081" > /tmp/t15-p2.log 2>&1 &
MVN_PID=$!

  if ! kill -0 $MVN_PID 2>/dev/null; then echo "mvn died phase2"; tail -40 /tmp/t15-p2.log; exit 1; fi
  sleep 1
done

DETAIL=$(curl -sf "http://127.0.0.1:18081/api/tickets/$ID")
echo "DETAIL=$DETAIL"
printf '%s' "$DETAIL" | python3 -c 'import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d["title"]=="T15 restart check"; assert len(d["comments"])==1 and d["comments"][0]["body"]=="Comment before restart"; print("T15 RESTART OK")'

JAVA_PID=$(pgrep -f 'server.port=18081' | head -1)
kill $JAVA_PID 2>/dev/null || true
kill $MVN_PID 2>/dev/null || true
sleep 2
echo DONE
```

```
ripgrep (rg) recursively searches the current directory for lines matching
a regex pattern. By default, ripgrep will respect gitignore rules and
```

```bash
    m=re.search(r'<testsuite[^>]*tests="(\d+)"[^>]*failures="(\d+)"[^>]*errors="(\d+)"[^>]*skipped="(\d+)"', text)
    if not m:
        m=re.search(r'tests="(\d+)"\s+skipped="(\d+)"\s+failures="(\d+)"\s+errors="(\d+)"', text)
        if m:
            a,sk,b,c=map(int,m.groups()); d=sk
        else:
            print('parse fail', path); continue
    else:
        a,b,c,d=map(int,m.groups())
    total+=a; f+=b; e+=c; s+=d
    name=path.split('TEST-')[-1].replace('.xml','')
    print(f'{name}: run={a} fail={b} err={c} skip={d}')
print(f'TOTAL tests={total} failures={f} errors={e} skipped={s}')
PY
# confirm build success in log
grep -E 'BUILD SUCCESS|BUILD FAILURE|Tests run:' /tmp/full-test2.log | tail -20
```
